articles.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
articles.snippet: Binance says it has fully lifted withdrawal suspensions imposed after October’s $6.3 billion hack, though a small number of networks remain paused for unrelated maintenance.

articles.title: Bitcoin little changed, DeFi tokens lead the bounce as U.S. marks Thanksgiving
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is holding near $60,800 after rebounding from Wednesday's $57,500 low, while DeFi and infrastructure tokens are gaining nearly twice as much.

articles.title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
articles.snippet: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

articles.title: Hackers Hit US Air Force Cloud System Running Air-Defense and Munitions Data
articles.snippet: The intrusion at Cloud One, discovered during a system upgrade, has prompted a Cyber Command damage assessment and disrupted the platform that runs air-defense radar feeds, munitions tracking and personnel data.

articles.title: Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension Four Weeks After $6.4B Hack
articles.snippet: Binance has restored all withdrawals after October's hack, as the U.S. says it has helped freeze, seize or return $2.9 billion of the funds.
